Definition: Pelajah, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Three men bear the name Pelaiah. One stands in the line of David's sons, and two are Levites of the return: one who helped the people understand the law when Ezra read it, and one who sealed the covenant with his brethren.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Levites who explained the law did as much as the kings who wrote it: Pelaiah's name stands among the teachers, and that is honour enough.
